title: p-curve-v1 task input
description: A SET of independent statistically-significant findings (p < .05), each supplied as a test statistic. The player must judge whether the set has evidential value by the p-curve method (Simonsohn, Nelson & Simons, 2014): do the significant p-values show the right-skew expected from real, well-powered effects? At least 5 findings per task so the p-curve is meaningful.

findings.description: One entry per significant finding, given as a test statistic.

type.description: Kind of test statistic. p-curve only accepts F with df1 == 1; chi2 is on 1 df.

value.description: The observed test-statistic value (e.g. t, F, z, chi-square, or r).

df1.description: Numerator df for F (must be 1); for t this carries the t df; for chi2 it is 1. Omit for z and r.

df2.description: Denominator df for F, or the t df when supplied separately. Omit for z, chi2, r.

n.description: Sample size, REQUIRED for type 'r' (so df = n - 2 for the exact p-value). Omit for other types.
